messages:
maya: FYI telemetry: v1 request timeouts climb for payloads with many long-context messages (>1500 tokens). Thinking of a tenant-facing 'deprecate-new' toggle: hide v1 from new route creation, keep pinned routes, run compatibility probes.

diego: we should be explicit about billing & quota. Probe traffic must not accidentally bill tenants. Could we route probes to an internal probe bucket and emit a non-billable metric?

ari: also need to avoid surprise capacity shifts. Console should estimate the delta and warn if enabling will move >8% tenant traffic and push v2 cluster past safe usage.

maya: implementation idea: tenant toggle -> start sampled probes (0.5%) mirrored to v2 with tag 'compat_probe' (non-billable), hide v1 in create-route dropdown, surface per-route seqlen histogram + estimated token delta, and require opt-in for any bulk unpin.

ops-bot: ops-bot: feature flag fae.console.deprecate_new_v1 created, targeting staging & canary

diego: alert rules: if probe error-rate delta >6% or model-quality drift >12%, pause the deprecate_new toggle and notify tenant + ops. Add runbook step to set probe_rate=0 and disable flag.

ari: UI copy draft: "Hide legacy v1 for NEW route creation. Existing pinned routes will remain. Run sampled compatibility probes to estimate migration risk. Probes are sampled and do not count toward billing by default." Tooltip: "Probes are routed to a non-billable internal bucket; we emit capacity metrics to inform scaling but do not bill these tokens."

maya: I'll open a tiny PR with wireframes and the backend contract flags: fae.console.deprecate_new_v1.enabled, fae.console.deprecate_new_v1.probe_rate, fae.console.deprecate_new_v1.probe_bucket, fae.console.deprecate_new_v1.bulk_unpin_optin. Tagging @diego @ari for review.
